source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Disease coverage includes Cercospora leaf spot, powdery mildew, and soybean mosaic virus, each described with visible symptoms (leaf spotting, white powdery coating, and mosaic/mottled leaf patterns respectively) and general control recommendations (resistant/clean seed, field sanitation, and fungicide use where the disease is a recurring problem).
